worked_example.defect: market_sizing.validation.passed=False and publishable=False; the report renders the banner 'Failed validation - figures withheld' AND, in the same document, 'a massive $1.22B TAM' with a 65/100 market-opportunity score built on it.
worked_example.why_the_gate_misses_it: D09 checks that publishable is False and that a withhold banner EXISTS in the html. It never checks that the withheld number stays OUT of the prose. The gate verifies a disclosure was printed, not that the report obeys it.

what_this_means: 219/219 is not evidence of quality. The invariants read structure (does a field exist, do two fields agree); the defects that remain are semantic (does the prose honour what the structure says). Continuing to add invariants of the same shape should not be expected to move this number.
